selection.name: Fiend's Grip
selection.description: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every 0.5 seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Spawns 2 illusions that channel Fiend's Grip on the target instead, allowing the caster to perform other actions. Additionally steals 5% of the target's maximum health per second. +6s Fiend's Grip duration.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Cooldown reduced by 50 seconds. For every second spent channelling Fiend's Grip, cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

selection.name: Fiery Soul
selection.description: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time caster casts a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts 8 seconds.
selection.differences: Generates stacks when casting spells instead of when damaging enemies with spells.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Increases the attack speed bonus by 20 and the movement speed bonus by 2%.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Stacks infinitely and grants 2 stacks per spell cast instead of 1.

selection.name: Finger of Death
selection.description: Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out. Deals massive damage and grows stronger with each life it consumes.
selection.differences: Has greatly increased duration to gain Finger of Death kill stacks.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: +70 Max HP and +20 more bonus damage per Finger of Death kill.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: -20 seconds cooldown. 100 more base damage and is cast on all enemies in a 325 radius of the primary target.

selection.name: Firesnap Cookie
selection.description: The hero feeds a potent cookie to themselves or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Firesnap cookies become even more potent, getting increased jump range and launching a Mortimer Kiss to the landing destination. Heals units for 200 and grants 200 max health.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: For 3 seconds, the target gets thrown an additional Firesnap Cookie every 1 seconds.

selection.name: Fissure
selection.description: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
selection.differences: Allies can freely walk on Fissure.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Increases range by 320 and damage by 80.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Grants Aftershock (only works for spells cast while on the fissure). Also creates a secondary perpendicular fissure in front of the first unit hit.

selection.name: Mortimer Kisses
selection.description: The caster launches a barrage of firespit globs over 5.5 seconds. Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time. The caster has a reduced turn rate for the duration and a minimum launch range of 600.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: +20% slow, and +20 burn damage per second. Given Gobble Up ability.

additionalSelection: Mortimer Kisses uses the same official full-catalog SHA; included only to establish AA glob values,not grant rank.
